As Sommelier (m/f/d), you will enrich the Kulm Hotel with your expertise, craft tailored wine recommendations for our discerning international guests, and actively contribute to the success of our house.
• You are a passionate host, inspiring our guests during daily service, events, and banquets with expert, charming advice on the perfect wine pairings.

• The wine cellar is your passion: You assist in the professional care, organization, and proper storage of our exclusive wine collection.

• You actively support the F&B team in implementing innovative wine and spirits concepts to create unique taste experiences for our guests.

• With a trained eye, you ensure compliance with the highest quality and hygiene standards, as well as the smooth preparation and supply of wines across all outlets. | This is you:
• A completed vocational qualification in hospitality or gastronomy, ideally complemented by formal sommelier training (e.g., Sommelier Diploma, WSET Level 3, or equivalent qualification).

• Professional experience as a Sommelier or wine-focused service team member in fine dining or luxury hospitality.

• A deep passion for the world of wines and spirits, combined with excellent communication skills, poise, and a strong guest-oriented approach.

• High team spirit, flexibility, and a genuine drive to continuously expand your knowledge.

• Business-fluent German and very good English skills; Italian is a strong asset. | Benefits: At the Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous discounts.

Responsabilità - Sei un ospite appassionato, ispirando i nostri ospiti durante il servizio quotidiano, eventi e banchetti con consigli esperti e affascinanti sulle combinazioni di vini perfette. - In stretta collaborazione con i nostri Responsabili Sommelier e Restaurant, contribuisci a fornire idee per allineare perfettamente le raccomandazioni di vino e bevande con i nostri menu e concetti di outlet. - La cantina è la tua passione: assiste nella cura professionale, organizzazione e stoccaggio adeguato della nostra esclusiva collezione di vini.

jobs.description:
Housekeeping Supervisor (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz (Grand Hotel Kronenhof), Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Pensum: 100%. Vertrag: 10-Monats-Stelle / 10-month contract. Stellenantritt: 2026-08-01.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture: | This is what you move with us:
• Quality Assurance: You conduct daily inspections of guest rooms, suites, and public areas, ensuring that our high standards of cleanliness, presentation, and service are consistently maintained.

• Operational Support: You actively support the Housekeeping team in daily operations and help ensure smooth workflows across all assigned areas.

• Team Coordination: You organize daily housekeeping activities, coordinate room assignments, and ensure that priorities are executed efficiently and on time.

• Training & Onboarding: You assist in the onboarding of new team members and provide ongoing on-the-job training and coaching to maintain and continuously improve service quality.

• Control & Documentation: You report maintenance issues, oversee Lost & Found procedures, and ensure compliance with internal policies as well as health, safety, and hygiene standards.

• Interdepartmental Communication: You work closely with the Front Office, Engineering, and Laundry teams to deliver an exceptional guest experience and ensure efficient communication between departments. | This is you: You understand that outstanding housekeeping is often the art of the unseen – everything is impeccable, allowing guests to enjoy a flawless and comfortable stay.
• Experience: You have a professional background in hospitality and ideally previous experience as a Floor Supervisor, Housekeeping Supervisor, or in a similar role within a luxury hotel environment.

• Languages: You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of German, Italian, Portuguese, or any additional language is considered a strong asset.

• Organizational Skills: You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• Resilience: You are physically fit, enjoy being hands-on, and appreciate the balance between operational responsibilities and administrative tasks.

• Personality: You possess a strong eye for detail, a proactive mindset, a positive attitude, and the ability to motivate and lead by example.

• Flexibility: You are willing to work shifts, including weekends and public holidays, according to operational needs. | Benefits: At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

Where historic charm meets modern luxury – Grand Hotel Kronenhof in Pontresina is one of the most renowned 5-star superior hotels in Switzerland. Overlooking the fascinating Engadin mountain scenery, we celebrate hospitality at the highest level. To perfectly present this magical place for our guests, we are looking for a personality who has cleanliness, elegance and leadership in their blood. | This is what you move with us: As Executive Housekeeper, you are the driving force behind the impeccable appearance of our hotel. You report directly to the Rooms Division Manager and lead an international team of approximately 24 employees.

• Quality assurance at 5-star level: You ensure impeccable cleanliness and living quality in all guest rooms and public areas – always in line with the demanding standards of Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes and Leading Quality Assurance (LQA). You are also responsible for our staff accommodation.

• Interface professional: You are in daily contact with the Executive Management, Engineering, Floristry and Front Office to ensure smooth housekeeping operations. | This is you:

• Your language skills: Must-have: Fluent German or English. Advantageous: Knowledge of Italian and/or Portuguese.

Responsibilities
Are you a proactive sales professional with a passion for luxury hospitality? Do you thrive on forging strong client relationships, driving commercial growth, and shaping bespoke experiences in iconic destinations?As we continue transforming our Events organization across Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina, we are looking for a commercially driven Event Sales Manager to join our Brand & Commercial Team.This is not a traditional operational planning role—it is a strategic, business-development-focused position where you own the client’s commercial journey from pitch to contract.
- Proactive Business Development: Identify and secure new luxury MICE, corporate, and high-end social event opportunities across both iconic properties, with a focus on growing shoulder-period business.

Requirements

- Mindset: A proactive, commercially driven sales hunter who excels at networking, negotiation, and building genuine long-term relationships.
- Tech & Tool Savvy: Solid experience with hotel PMS, CRM, event management systems, and MS Office 365.

- Bridge Builder: Ability to align commercial targets with operational realities while maintaining high standards of client satisfaction.

What we offer
What we Offer:

En tant que membre du groupe de luxe Kulm, vous faites partie de la clé de notre succès. Ensemble, nous faisons de chaque séjour une source d'inspiration profonde, unique et distinctive. Et en tant que telle, nous acceptons notre culture: luxe sous-estimé, inspiration et expérience de vie. Ensemble, nous faisons en sorte que cela se produise.

C'est toi.

- Soins aux clients au plus haut niveau : Réception chaleureuse de nos clients et service professionnel et en douceur au comptoir Concierge. - Normes de luxe : Conformité et application active des normes de Leading Quality Assurance (LQA) et Forbes tout au long du voyage des clients. - S'acquitter des souhaits individuels : Assistance personnalisée allant des recommandations d'initiés et des réservations de restaurants à l'organisation d'expériences sur mesure dans l'Engadin.

- Coordination & Logistique : organisation sans faille des arrivées et des départs, des bagages et des services de stationnement des valets, ainsi que de la coordination de toutes les navettes et transferts. - Gestion des relations : Construire et maintenir d'excellentes relations avec les partenaires locaux, les chemins de fer de montagne, les organisateurs d'événements et les prestataires de services régionaux. - Communication intersectorielle : assurer un flux d'informations impeccable au sein de l'équipe Concierge et une collaboration étroite entre tous les départements. - Entretien de la flotte et des équipements : Surveiller l'entretien et la maintenance de la flotte hôtelière et des équipements opérationnels.

C'est ce que tu déménages avec nous.

- Expérience professionnelle : Plusieurs années d'expérience en tant que concierge dans l'industrie hôtelière 5 étoiles. - Normes de service de luxe : Connaissances solides et expérience pratique avec les normes LQA et Forbes. - Connaissances locales & Passion : Excellente connaissance de la région d'Engadin et de la région, ou la motivation pour l'acquérir rapidement. -composition & Présence : mentalité d'hospitalité exceptionnelle, compétences diplomatiques en négociation, discrétion absolue et une apparence polie.

- Style de travail et mobilité : approche indépendante et hautement structurée du travail, compétences numériques et permis de conduire de catégorie B valide. - Compétences linguistiques : l'allemand et l'anglais des affaires, des langues étrangères supplémentaires sont un atout.

Avantages

Chez Kulm Group, nos collaborateurs sont au cœur de notre succès. Nous offrons des possibilités de développement attrayantes, des hébergements confortables, des repas abordables dans le restaurant du personnel et de nombreux avantages.

Requisiti - Formazione: Hai completato la formazione in ristorante o gestione alberghiera. - Esperienza: Hai esperienza professionale di servizio e capire le esigenze di alta qualità ospitalità. - Capacità linguistiche: Si parla correntemente l'inglese e idealmente il tedesco. Ulteriori competenze linguistiche sono un plus. - Aspetto: Il vostro aspetto curato e le buone maniere rendono il rappresentante perfetto della nostra struttura. - Passione per il servizio: Sai cosa fa la differenza e sempre cercare i migliori risultati.

Cosa offriamo - Vantaggi: Al Gruppo Kulm, i nostri dipendenti sono la chiave del nostro successo. Siamo famosi per il nostro servizio impeccabile, così come la nostra passione per il lusso di fascia alta, sport invernali e haute phinsine. Con noi, troverete non solo la piattaforma perfetta per far avanzare la vostra carriera, ma anche una straordinaria esperienza di dipendenti con numerosi servizi e benefici.
